OK, I'm hungry. Let me see. The fish soup looks good, and it's cold today, so I'll have a bowl of soup. And bread? Yes, I'll take two pieces. My husband loves cheese, so I'll buy some cheese for him too. Wine? No, I won't buy wine today. We have a bottle at the hotel. Oh, look, fresh strawberries! They are cheap, so I'll take a box for the children. Oh no, it's raining. I don't have an umbrella. OK, I'll wait here ten minutes and I'll have a coffee.

Good evening, Mr. Silva. Front desk, how can I help? Your key doesn't work? I'm sorry. No problem, I'll send a new key to your room in five minutes. A taxi for tomorrow? Of course, I'll call one for six thirty. And breakfast? The restaurant opens at seven, but I'll ask the kitchen for a coffee at six. Don't worry, I won't forget. Anything else? An umbrella? Yes, I'll leave one at the door for you. Have a good night, Mr. Silva.

The waiter told us about the fish, the soup and the salad. I said, I'll have the fish. Claire said, I'll try the soup. The bill came, and Claire said, I'll pay this time. I said, OK, but I'll leave the tip.
